text: This report recommends that City Council approve the conservation strategy for the heritage properties located at 309-311 and 349 George Street (together, the Site"), situated within the Garden District Heritage Conservation District (GDHCD), in connection with proposed Official Plan and Zoning By-law amendment applications. The properties at 309-311 George Street contain a pair of three-storey semi-detached houses known as the Robert Armstrong Houses. The property at 349 George Street contains the Allan School which has close historical ties to the important Toronto Boys' Home (now demolished) and a historical association with the Garden District neighbourhood. All properties subject of this report are owned by the City of Toronto.
